mapper.select: select count(id) > 0 from iot_model_api_config where value=concat('#', #{name}) limit 1
select count(id) > 0 from iot_model_attr where resolver=#{key} limit 1

select b.name, a.api_code apiCode, a.protocol_attr_name attrName, p.name productName, p.code productCode from iot_model_api_config a left join iot_model_api b on a.api_code=b.code left join iot_product p on p.id = a.product_id where value=concat('#', #{key})
